kurz: The same lemonade, once ice-cold and once at room temperature: the warm one tastes noticeably sweeter, although it contains the same sugar.
bild_im_kopf: Like a volume knob that the cold turns down.
beobachtung: The room-temperature lemonade tastes much sweeter and stickier, the cold one fresher and less sweet.
erklaerung: The sweet sensor on the tongue works harder when warm. That is why cold drinks and ice cream contain a lot of sugar you barely notice.
schritte: Chill one glass with ice and leave the other at room temperature.
Pour the same amount of lemonade into each, let the cold one chill for a few minutes, remove the ice.
Taste them in turn, drinking water in between.
material: a bottle of lemonade or apple juice
